SOCIOLOGY · FIRST-YEAR ESSAY

A place to belong

The role of community in student wellbeing

Starting university is more than an academic transition. For many students, it is the first time they have lived away from home.

A sense of belonging helphelps students feel more confident in this new environment. Due to the fact that friendships are important, they can have an impact on how students feel.Supportive friendships can improve students’ wellbeing.

Research suggests that social connection supports adjustment to university (Taylor 2023)(Taylor, 2023). Creating spaces where students can connect is therefore an important part of campus life.
